consts:
Shrink the document text sent to the AI reader - losslessly for our purpose.

Why
---
``acquire_recipe`` only needs the model to (a) name the layout, (b) read the
header fields, (c) report a REPRESENTATIVE SAMPLE of real order lines, and
(d) report each block's printed TOTAL. It explicitly does NOT need every row:
the offline parser re-extracts all rows from the full ``pages`` tokens.

Real POs are dominated by material the prompt already tells the model to
ignore - per-page boilerplate notices, pack break-up tables, bare
sub-breakdown restatements. On a 48-page LPP order that is ~80% of the text,
and it costs real wall-time twice over: prefill on the way in, and a slower,
more distracted answer on the way out.

This module drops those repeats while guaranteeing that everything the
synthesis step depends on survives:

* every TOTAL / SUBTOTAL / SUMMARY row              -> block_total_qty gate
* every order-block marker (Order No / Entity ...)  -> entity_anchor + po_nos
* the first ``keep_priced`` rows of each distinct   -> line_pattern samples
  priced-row shape, counted per order block
* the head of the document                          -> header anchors

Lines are only ever DROPPED, never rewritten, so any ``raw_line`` the model
copies from the compressed text is still findable verbatim in the full text.

Structural signature of a row: values collapse, structure survives.

    ``014KK-89X-L LADIES` TROUSERS 89X 89X DARK BROWN PCS 310 8.77 2,718.70``
    and the same row for another colour/size share a signature, so only the
    first few of that shape are kept.
A real order row carries a unit price: >=2 numbers, >=1 decimal.

Return a shorter equivalent of ``text`` for the AI read.

    Never edits a line, so ``raw_line`` round-trips against the full document.
